title: Common K-flat roofs for ordinary tensor resolutions
statement: Every map of second complexes admits a common K-flat roof with quasi-isomorphic augmentations and a homotopy commutative comparison.

proof.text: Use the existing module-object functorial flat cover on A = ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y. Reduce the resulting LeftResolution of the inclusion of flat objects, obtaining the explicit resolutionFunctor and its natural quasi-isomorphism resolutionNatTrans. Tensor preserves integer-indexed colimits by closedness and symmetry; these colimits are exact because A is Grothendieck abelian. The source theorem LeftResolution.kFlat_resolutionFunctor_obj gives categorical K-flatness of each resolution value. This uses the same reduced resolution API as the unbounded K-flat existence node, retaining its functoriality on complexes.

For each resolution value P and acyclic N, the zero map from the zero complex to N is a quasi-isomorphism. Categorical K-flatness makes its image under tensorRight P a quasi-isomorphism. Additivity makes the source tensor zero acyclic, hence N tensor P is acyclic. Transfer exactness in every degree through GenericOrdinaryTensor.ordinaryTotalIso(P,N), from the ordinary total to N tensor P, to obtain NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P.

For g:Q to Q-prime take K and K-prime to be the values of the same reduced resolutionFunctor and u its image of g. The two components of resolutionNatTrans are quasi-isomorphisms. Their naturality square commutes strictly, and Homotopy.ofEq turns this equality into the required chain homotopy.

proof_origin.place: LeftResolution.kFlat_resolutionFunctor_obj and resolutionNatTrans.naturality; GenericOrdinaryTensor.ordinaryTotalIso. The existing functorial resolution construction avoids the homotopy-category common-refinement step.

lean.statement: theorem native_ordinary_tensor_model_resolution_roof (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u}) : ∀ (Q Q' : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ) (g : Q ⟶ Q'), ∃ (K K' : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ) (hK : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y K) (hK' : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y K') (q : K ⟶ Q) (q' : K' ⟶ Q') (u : K ⟶ K'), QuasiIso q ∧ QuasiIso q' ∧ Nonempty (Homotopy (u ≫ q') (q ≫ g))
